title: Extract chromatin contact evidence from .cool
description: Strictly read a project-supplied Cooler HDF5 contact map and explicitly typed regulatory BED table to produce bounded, descriptive cis enhancer-promoter contact candidates with reloadable provenance.
questions: Which explicitly labeled same-chromosome enhancer-promoter pairs have declared raw contact counts and distance-stratified descriptive evidence in the supplied single-resolution .cool map?
preconditions: The .cool map, declared contact assay, genome build, resolution, matrix processing policy and replicate identity are available; regulatory elements use the same build and have stable unique identifiers with explicit enhancer or promoter types; output path is new.
assumptions: For the requested descriptive screen, raw cis pixel count and the median of available cis pixels at the same bin distance are useful reportable quantities. They are not a calibrated interaction significance model.

quality_gates.description: Block unless a stable HDF5::Cooler .cool input, explicit typed BED elements, shared genome build, contact assay, replicate identity, resolution and source digests are declared. Do not infer element types from identifiers.
Require consistent chromosome, bin and upper-triangular pixel arrays; finite nonnegative counts; and an unambiguous mapping of every submitted element midpoint to exactly one contact-map bin.

Reload the report and reconcile input digests, HDF5 layout, contact-map resolution, explicit element labels, assay, replicate identity, candidate count, truncation policy and descriptive normalization before interpretation.

Do not label a descriptive candidate a significant loop, TAD, enhancer-promoter assignment, regulated gene, condition effect, or causal interaction without validated normalization, replicate-aware analysis, appropriate statistical calling and orthogonal evidence.

limitations: This module accepts single-resolution .cool only; it does not read .hic or multiresolution .mcool inputs. It does not balance matrices, call loops or TADs, calculate p values, model copy number or coverage, assess replicates, compare conditions, derive enhancers/promoters, or establish regulatory function. It does not install or manage dependency environments, execution infrastructure, remote job systems, or model-hosting infrastructure.

dependencies.purpose: Read project-supplied Cooler HDF5 arrays without modification.
